title: Points of interest
description: How points of interest are placed in the neutral zone (CB-8c, CB-8d): the chance that a plot band gets one, the margin from the band edges and the buffs a point can have. The tries per point are mapgen.json placementTries. The numbers of each buff kind are not here yet (CB-8g).

chancePercent.description: Chance in percent that a plot band gets a point.

bandMarginCells.description: Cells kept free at each edge of a band. Twice it must be below plotWidth.

buffs.description: The buffs a point can have; one weighted pick in file order.
